mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (uuid, username, password_hash, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT INTO `user_detail` ( user_uuid, nickname, phone, email, avatar_url, credit_score, bio, school, major, grade, interests, tags, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userUuid}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{avatarUrl}, #{creditScore}, #{bio}, #{school}, #{major}, #{grade}, #{interests, typeHandler=com.campushub.util.JsonListTypeHandler}, #{tags, typeHandler=com.campushub.util.JsonListTypeHandler}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE `user_detail` SET nickname = #{nickname}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, credit_score = #{creditScore}, bio = #{bio}, school = #{school}, major = #{major}, grade = #{grade}, interests = #{interests, typeHandler=com.campushub.util.JsonListTypeHandler}, tags = #{tags, typeHandler=com.campushub.util.JsonListTypeHandler}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE user_uuid = #{userUuid}
mapper.select: SELECT user_uuid, nickname, phone, email, avatar_url, credit_score, bio, school, major, grade, interests, tags, create_time, update_time FROM `user_detail` WHERE user_uuid = #{uuid}
SELECT u.uuid, u.username, u.password_hash, u.status, u.create_time, u.update_time FROM `user` u JOIN `user_detail` ud ON u.uuid = ud.user_uuid WHERE ud.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickname}, '%')
SELECT uuid, username, password_hash, status, create_time, update_time FROM `user`
